name: Find
use: Use to reach one animal by typing part of her ear tag or her pen, from anywhere: type, tap one, act. A white input page with the field pinned and focused; nothing is listed before typing; results are one card per unit, this unit first. Farrowing's Find a sow, Inspection's and Home's Find a pig.
notUse: Not for picking from a short known list (use ChoiceList or a picker); not for narrowing a list already on screen (use FilterSheet); not for collecting several animals (use Scan).
states: Results · this unit first, then the others

name: Scan
use: Use to collect animals hands-free with the tag reader: every scan adds her to a list, newest first; a repeat scan lights her row; tap one to open her, or tick several for the context's Actions. A Sheet page on the tint whose rows are the context's own animal row with its tick box.
notUse: Not for finding one animal by typing (use Find); never with a Not-found row or a Select button (owner, 2026-10-12).
